resources:
  - "assets/img/travel/*.jpg"

<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/vendor/leaflet/leaflet.css"/>

<style>
#travel-map {
  height: 72vh;
  min-height: 480px;
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: 10px;
  z-index: 1;
}
.travel-popup img {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 300px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  margin-top: 6px;
  display: block;
}
.travel-popup .city {
  font-size: 1.05em;
}
</style>

A few of the places I've been lucky enough to visit — drag the map, click a
pin to see the photo.

<div id="travel-map"></div>

<script src="assets/vendor/leaflet/leaflet.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  var map = L.map('travel-map', { worldCopyJump: true }).setView([32, 10], 2);

  L.tileLayer('https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    maxZoom: 18,
    attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a> contributors'
  }).addTo(map);

  var places = [
    { name: "Austin",        country: "USA",    lat: 30.2672,  lng: -97.7431,  img: "austin.jpg" },
    { name: "Boston",       country: "USA",    lat: 42.3601,  lng: -71.0589,  img: "boston.jpg" },
    { name: "Cancun",       country: "Mexico", lat: 21.1619,  lng: -86.8515,  img: "cancun.jpg" },
    { name: "Chengdu",      country: "China",  lat: 30.5728,  lng: 104.0668,  img: "chengdu.jpg" },
    { name: "Chongqing",    country: "China",  lat: 29.5630,  lng: 106.5516,  img: "chongqing.jpg" },
    { name: "Galveston",    country: "USA",    lat: 29.3013,  lng: -94.7977,  img: "galveston.jpg" },
    { name: "Hong Kong",    country: "China",  lat: 22.3193,  lng: 114.1694,  img: "hong-kong.jpg" },
    { name: "Los Angeles",  country: "USA",    lat: 34.0522,  lng: -118.2437, img: "los-angeles.jpg" },
    { name: "Macao",        country: "China",  lat: 22.1987,  lng: 113.5439,  img: "macao.jpg" },
    { name: "Monterrey",    country: "Mexico", lat: 25.6866,  lng: -100.3161, img: "monterrey.jpg" },
    { name: "Minneapolis",  country: "USA",    lat: 44.9778,  lng: -93.2650,  img: "minneapolis.jpg" },
    { name: "New York",     country: "USA",    lat: 40.7128,  lng: -74.0060,  img: "new-york.jpg" },
    { name: "Shanghai",     country: "China",  lat: 31.2304,  lng: 121.4737,  img: "shanghai.jpg" },
    { name: "Shenzhen",     country: "China",  lat: 22.5431,  lng: 114.0579,  img: "shenzhen.jpg" },
    { name: "Tokyo",        country: "Japan",  lat: 35.6762,  lng: 139.6503,  img: "tokyo.jpg" },
    { name: "Vancouver",    country: "Canada", lat: 49.2827,  lng: -123.1207, img: "vancouver.jpg" },
    { name: "Xi'an",        country: "China",  lat: 34.3416,  lng: 108.9398,  img: "xian.jpg" }
  ];

  places.forEach(function (p) {
    var marker = L.circleMarker([p.lat, p.lng], {
      radius: 8,
      color: '#0d6efd',
      weight: 2,
      fillColor: '#0d6efd',
      fillOpacity: 0.7
    }).addTo(map);
    marker.bindPopup(
      '<div class="travel-popup">' +
        '<span class="city"><strong>' + p.name + '</strong>, ' + p.country + '</span>' +
        '<img src="assets/img/travel/' + p.img + '" alt="' + p.name + '" loading="lazy"/>' +
      '</div>',
      { maxWidth: 320 }
    );
  });
})();
</script>
